findings.summary: CSS/HTML extraction is feasible with existing caller and rendering contracts retained; it is not automatically a save-schema change.
evidence: $menu:4-7 already provides layout_style return mode.
$menu:11-12 repairs a saved malformed menu HTML attribute at the common input.

findings.saveImpact: Pure renderer/style extraction can retain all variable roots and saved state numbers. Keep layout_style and other public modes returning equivalent strings, preserve CSS cascade/DOM IDs and load order, and refresh saved HTML only when needed. New global render caches would be new persisted derived variables unless local/cleared; no new gameplay field is inherently necessary.
